# Mario Grugan

> Personal portfolio of Mario Grugan — a Statistics & Data Science student at Carnegie Mellon University (Pittsburgh, PA) working across machine learning, data analysis, and large-scale social platforms reaching 15M+ followers. This site documents his projects, background, and contact details.

## Who is Mario Grugan?

- Statistics & Data Science undergraduate at Carnegie Mellon University in Pittsburgh, PA.
- Social media lead for Carnegie Mellon Racing (a 150-member Formula Hybrid / FSAE team); led a campaign that raised a record $37,000.
- Operates an Instagram network reaching 15M+ followers and 120M+ monthly impressions, including @ocean.destinations (5.2M+ followers).
- Applies statistics and machine learning to optimize reach, engagement, and monetization across the network.
- Contact: mgrugan@andrew.cmu.edu

## Key pages

- [Home](https://mariogrugan.com/): Overview of Mario Grugan and selected work in data, machine learning, and social platforms.
- [About](https://mariogrugan.com/about.html): Background in statistics, engineering, and social media growth, with key metrics (15M+ followers, 120M+ monthly impressions, $37k raised for CMR).
- [Work](https://mariogrugan.com/portfolio.html): Full project portfolio with context, tools, and outcomes.
- [Contact](https://mariogrugan.com/contact.html): Email and contact form for projects and collaboration.

## Projects

- [Wysdom AI](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wysdom-ai/id6756771387): AI-powered study platform (iOS/Android/Web) that turns notes, slides, and study guides into an infinite feed of active-recall questions. Built with React Native, Expo, and an LLM pipeline that summarizes material and generates multiple-choice questions, flashcards, and open-response prompts.
- [Signal](https://mgrugan.github.io/signal/): Client-side SEO & GEO audit tool that crawls up to 60 pages and scores a site 0–100 for classic search and AI answer engines, then generates an action plan plus robots.txt and llms.txt. Built with vanilla JavaScript and the Google Gemini API.
- [Social Media Agency](https://github.com/mgrugan/agency): A portfolio of high-growth Instagram accounts totaling 15M+ followers (including @ocean.destinations at 5M+), generating 100M+ organic impressions per month, built over 8+ years.
- Formula Hybrid Optimization (2025): R-based study modeling Formula Hybrid / FSAE endurance scoring against lap time and energy use, then numerically optimizing for total points (endurance model R² = 0.988).
- AI Chess (2023): A full chess engine built from scratch in Python for CMU 15-112, with complete rules and an AI opponent, on cmu_graphics.
- Social Signals (2022): Python analysis of bias and emotion in political social-media posts using pandas, NLTK sentiment scoring, and matplotlib.
